== Course of events ==

After Dorothy had waited three sad days for word from Oz, he summoned her on the fourth day and proposed crossing the desert by balloon, since he could not make a cyclone to carry her home. He explained that the balloon would be made of silk coated with glue and would float on hot air rather than gas. To make this possible, Oz lights a fire beneath the balloon to fill it with hot air.

As part of the same preparations, Oz declares that the Scarecrow will rule in his absence, entrusting leadership to him while the balloon is made ready. This declaration set the stage for what followed: Oz's admission that he was tired of being a humbug ruling in secret, his plan to leave together with Dorothy, and the balloon's departure without her when the ropes snapped before she could board, carrying Oz away alone as the city mourned his loss.
